title: Practice 9: Irregular comparatives: лучше, больше, старше

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Today is scorching hot, so dress light.
exercises.why: "**старее**" and "**более старый**" are comparative forms from "**старый**". — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 80–82.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: "**старее**" and "**более старый**" are comparative forms from "**старый**".

exercises.prompt: An airship is lighter than air.
exercises.why: light; easy — лёгкий — легче. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 80–82.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Freshly pressed juice is more expensive than juice from concentrate.
exercises.why: dear, expensive — дорогой — дороже. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 80–82.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Знаете ли вы, что Окинава ___ (близкий) к Китаю, чем к Хонсю?
exercises.prompt: Are you aware that Okinawa is closer to China than to Honshu?
exercises.why: близко — ближе. далеко — дальше. много — больше. мало — меньше. хорошо — лучше. плохо — хуже. легко — легче. громко — громче. долго — дольше. высоко — выше. низко — ниже. жарко — жарче. дорого — дороже. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 80–82.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Шерсть альпаки ___ (мягкий) овечьей, но и дороже.
exercises.prompt: Alpaca wool is softer than sheep wool, but also more expensive.
exercises.why: "**старее**" and "**более старый**" are comparative forms from "**старый**". — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 80–82.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: "**старее**" and "**более старый**" are comparative forms from "**старый**".

exercises.prompt: Trump is four years younger than Biden.
exercises.why: "**старше**" and "**старший**", however, mean "older" in age or "senior" in rank: *Мой брат старше меня на два года.* The forms "**моложе**" and "**более молодой**" mean "younger" in age, while "**младше**" and "**младший**" may mean either younger in age or junior in rank. рано — раньше. поздно — позже. редко — реже. часто — чаще. близко — ближе. далеко — дальше. много — больше. мало — меньше. хорошо — лучше. плохо — хуже. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 80–82.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: "**старше**" and "**старший**", however, mean "older" in age or "senior" in rank: *Мой брат старше меня на два года.* The forms "**моложе**" and "**более молодой**" mean "younger" in age,…
